source.title: Frontiers in the Study of Chaotic Dynamical Systems with Open Problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL with identifier 5833175.

Direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/5833175 returned a Cloudflare challenge/403, so the zbMATH REST API was used only as resolver metadata. The API identified the exact source as the 2011 World Scientific edited book Frontiers in the Study of Chaotic Dynamical Systems with Open Problems, DOI 10.1142/8089, ISBNs 9789814340694 and 9789814340700, with publisher link https://www.worldscientific.com/worldscibooks/10.1142/8089.

Identifier-specific recovery checked DOI metadata through Crossref and OpenAlex. Crossref confirmed the same title and World Scientific DOI landing page. OpenAlex reported open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, no best_oa_location, and no repository full text or PDF URL.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched by exact title plus PDF, ISBN 9789814340700 plus PDF, exact title plus open problems, and DOI 10.1142/8089. Inspected and rejected candidates included the World Scientific landing page, Google Books limited preview, CiNii bibliographic record, retail ebook pages, and third-party upload/slide pages. The publisher, retail, and library pages were metadata, preview, blocked, or paywalled; the third-party upload/slide pages were not accepted as source-authorized readable full text. Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted with metadata_only candidate pages.

Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source containing the technical problem statements. No questions were extracted because the available exact-work artifacts were metadata, limited previews, retail records, blocked pages, or non-source-authorized uploads.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/5833175.json and outputs/latest.json.
